summary: LearnSpace first-build validation. Backend: 14/14 pytest tests pass (100%) covering health, email/password auth (register/login/me/logout), role gating for /dashboard/student & /dashboard/admin/overview, invalid Google session_id, and _id leakage checks. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): Login/Register screens render with brand + testIDs; admin login navigates to Admin tabs with 4 metric cards; student login navigates to Student tabs with greeting, continue-learning hero, streak+badges, and 4 Mata Pelajaran cards; tapping a subject opens Course Detail with all 7 modules (Pre-Test, Materi, Video, Manual Book, Diskusi, Post-Test, Hasil) and Pre-Test is unlocked while the rest show locked indicators; Profile logout returns to Login; Register auto-logs in a new student.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: "shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow". Non-blocking but should be migrated for RN web.

action_items: Optional: migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow to silence RN-web deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Pydantic EmailStr rejects reserved TLDs like .test; keep test fixtures using @example.com (already applied in backend_test.py).
Backend consistently projects {_id: 0} and no _id leakage was observed across auth or dashboard responses.
Seeding is idempotent (checks existence by email) and matches /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
Session TTL managed via Mongo TTL index on user_sessions.expires_at; logout also hard-deletes the session document.
Role gating in dashboard.py raises 403 for the wrong role and get_current_user raises 401 for missing/invalid/expired tokens — matches spec.
seed_data_creation: None manually created. Seeded admin/student users are auto-provisioned by the backend startup hook. Backend test fixtures create ephemeral TEST_ users via /api/auth/register using @example.com.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend public URL = EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (https://learnspace-app.preview.emergentagent.com). Seeded accounts: admin@learnspace.app/Admin@123 and student@learnspace.app/Student@123. Use @example.com for register fixtures — Pydantic's EmailStr rejects reserved TLDs (.test/.invalid). Course modules use keys: pre_test, materials, videos, manual_book, discussion, post_test, results (testID=module-<key>). Student bottom tabs are Beranda/Kelas/Progres/Profil (match by text). Admin logout button has testID=admin-logout-button; student logout button has testID=logout-button on the Profile screen.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found. Initial playwright failure for course modules was a test-side mismatch — I had guessed shorter keys (pretest/materi/video/...) but the real testIDs are kebab/underscore (pre_test/materials/videos/manual_book/discussion/post_test/results). Re-run with correct keys produced 7/7.
